abstract: Goldman Sachs Research examines AI's impact on the global workforce, finding that young technology workers aged 20-30 have experienced elevated unemployment since early 2025, with the technology sector's employment share declining below its pre-pandemic trajectory. The analysis suggests broader labor market disruption in technology-intensive sectors as AI adoption accelerates.
keyFindings: Unemployment among young tech workers (ages 20-30) has increased approximately 3 percentage points since the start of 2025.
Tech employment share has fallen below pre-pandemic trend levels as of August 2025.
